_comment: Environment-specific PYNQ edge nodes. The NeuroSense PYNQ router reads this file (after NEUROSENSE_PYNQ_DEVICES and before the repo default) to list real boards alongside the pynq_sim_01 rehearsal stub. device_id is the mDNS name prefix (ws://{device_id}.local:8000/stream); address is an optional static IP for backends that cannot resolve .local. Empty by default so clean checkouts and tests list only the simulated stub.
